The build passed and I haven't merged, opened a pull request, or run cleanup.

- **Tasks:** All 3 passed on the free model on the first attempt, so none needed escalation. They were `001-inventory`, `002-orders` and `003-cli-stock`.
- **Review:** None ran. The runner set review to `skip`, so the passing tests decided it.
- **Size:** 6 files changed, 404 insertions. The diff is at `.freeloader/runs/stock-orders/feature.diff`.
- **Branch:** `freeloader/stock-orders/main`.
- **Test assumptions:** The planner wrote two tests on behaviour your spec doesn't state outright. A failed `reserve` does not use up its `order_id`, so a later `reserve` with the same id succeeds. `Inventory` keeps its own copy of `lines`, so changing the caller's dict afterwards has no effect.

To take the work, either merge locally with `git merge freeloader/stock-orders/main` or open a pull request. Cleanup comes after that, or if you abandon the feature.
